Adolion: The Adventurer's Road
Author view
Overview
Memory
⚑
Where you are
The Journey North
At the road north.
Something is starting to stir.
About this story
You have just signed on at the Adventurer's Guild in Aegis City, with no party yet. Belle, a headstrong barbarian, and Dalan, a shy elf ranger, are looking for one too. The postings on the board are small, the pay is modest, and every rank has to be earned. Expect frontier fantasy with a dark edge: real danger, mysteries that open one clue at a time, and choices that cost something. Bring any adventurer you like; the Guild takes all kinds.
Recently
You left The Wendhope Job behind and moved into The Journey North.
Max Nightriver formed the Short Straws with Belle and Dalan at the Adventurers' Guild in Aegis City, registering for the Wendhope quest under Ellie's pen. Belle accepted the partnership with a predatory grin while Dalan quietly hoped the party would last. They set out north on the road, with Belle warning that the village's silence and the high reward meant something dangerous awaited.
Open threads
The Wendhope reward is suspiciously high for a D-rank, hinting the job is more dangerous than it appears.
The Short Straws must deliver a full report to the Sheridans' representative on their return from Wendhope.
Belle will walk out on the Short Straws if the Wendhope job turns out to lack real fighting.
The party must survive the road north and whatever has silenced Wendhope, with Belle ready to leave if there is no real fight.
Dalan is quietly watching to see whether the Short Straws will hold together where his previous parties failed.
The story so far
Three days after signing the Adventurers' Guild register in Aegis City, the party held only a badge and no party, and the Guild sent no one out alone. At the quest counter, Tobias pointed them to a posting on Wendhope, a silent mining village in the north whose reward from the Sheridan family was larger than a collapsed mine warranted, while Ellie kept the Guild's book ready beside the board. Belle, a barbarian from the Mountains of Shadow with a greataxe as tall as she was, and Dalan, a quiet elf archer who had drifted between parties for a year, both sought a party of their own.
